mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the unemployment rate (more than 0.5 percentage points over three months) indicates accelerating labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE falls by more than 0.5pp over three months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts (HOUST above 900k) and retail sales (RSAFS above 420 billion) indicates a broad-based consumer demand surge that accelerates corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST > 900 and RSAFS > 420000.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 0.5% for three consecutive months), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced liquidity and higher discount rates.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and rising for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO above 100) signals robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is above 100.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts rate exceeding 950 thousand units indicates a strong housing market that boosts consumer confidence and corporate investment, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 950.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high unemployment (UNRATE > 7.5%) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signal an economic environment where the Federal Reserve is likely to maintain or ease monetary policy, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary accommodation for weak labor market
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 7.5% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: During a weak manufacturing cycle (INDPRO below 95), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to declining industrial output and reduced corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95.
